title: agent_bench.kb_tokens subtracts a request's partial output count from the prompt's growth
goal: kb_tokens subtracts the previous request's real output (the result event's count shared by the run's requests), not the stream's partial per-message count, so a run's pack_tokens is not over-counted where the prompt grew by more than the result's characters

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import agent_bench as a; u=lambda p,o: {"input_tokens":p,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":o}; assert a.kb_tokens([{"usage":u(1000,5),"results":[]},{"usage":u(1300,5),"results":[400]}])<=300-200
